objective: Neon Spire pure rules in src/shared: SpireConfig, TowerRules, PlazaRules, MarketRules, SpireEconomy and SpireProgress with unit specs for every GDD check value, a buy/sell property test, and SpireBalance.spec porting the pacing simulation.
inputs: docs/game-design/game5-gdd.md sections C to H, N, O and R
acceptance_criteria: Only the files listed for SPIRE-004 in docs/architecture/spire.md section 1 change
Every GDD R test exists and passes in lune run tests/run, with each spec registered once in tests/run.luau
No sequence of buys and sells increases credits (property test over 10,000 seeded sequences)
SpireBalance.spec keeps floors 5, 10, 15 and 20 within 30% of the GDD B targets
Relay, Night and Garden specs still pass unchanged
evidence: 2026-10-26, A10, branch game5/spire (uncommitted working tree): lune run tests/run -> 421/421 passed, 0 failed, 0 load errors (117 new tests in 7 specs; Relay, Night and Garden specs unchanged and passing).
SpireBalance.spec (Luau greedy sim on the real rules): floor 5 at 3.3 min (target 3.5), floor 10 at 17.5 (18), floor 15 at 37.0 (35), floor 20 at 83.2 (86); all within the 30% tolerance.
SpireEconomy.spec property: worth never rises over 10,000 seeded 12-op buy/upgrade/sell/place/move/sell sequences with random events including Flash Sale.
SpireProgress.spec property: sanitize never errors on 1,000 seeded junk records, always returns a valid profile, and is idempotent; apply gives equal results on copies.
stylua --check and selene clean on every SPIRE-004 file; node tools/validate-tasks.mjs passes.
notes: Deviations from docs/architecture/spire.md section 3 (spire.md not edited): (1) TowerRules.Result cannot be a Luau type alias (type packs cannot be aliased), so every change spells out (Profile, boolean, string?). (2) PlazaRules requires TowerRules for copy and the Vec3 type (no cycle; 3.0 lists only SpireConfig and MetaRules). (3) SpireProgress does not require MarketRules (the event is an argument). (4) SpireProgress.check also refuses args over 40 characters with [arg] so parse rejects a 41-digit arg. GDD conflict: C5 says a new profile has draw 1, but defaults (decision 0009 and spire.md) give an empty Data Farm, so draw is 0 until the first rack; tests follow the decision.
